Given the `wikilinks` extension with default settings, when `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]` is converted, then the output is `

read the guide

`.

Given the `wikilinks` extension with default settings, when `Some text with a [[WikiLink|shown]].` is converted, then the output is `

Some text with a shown.

`.
Given the `wikilinks` extension with default settings, when `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]` is converted, then the output does not contain `[[` and does not contain `|`.

Given the `wikilinks` extension with default settings, when `[[Getting Started | read the guide]]` is converted, then the output is `

read the guide

`.
Given the `wikilinks` extension with default settings, when `[[  Getting Started  |  read the guide  ]]` is converted, then the output equals the output for `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]`.

Given the extension with `base_url='/wiki/'`, `end_url='.html'` and `html_class='foo'`, when `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]` is converted, then the output is `

read the guide

`.

Given the extension with `html_class=''`, when `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]` is converted, then the output is `

read the guide

`.

Given the extension with a `build_url` callable that records its arguments and returns `/bar/`, when `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]` is converted, then the callable was called with `Getting Started`, `/` and `/`, and the output is `

read the guide

`.

Given the `wikilinks` extension with default settings, when `Some text with a [[WikiLink]].` is converted, then the output is `

Some text with a WikiLink.

`.

Given the `wikilinks` extension with default settings, when `[[ foo bar_baz ]]` is converted, then the output is `

foo bar_baz

`.

Given the `wikilinks` extension with default settings, when `foo [[ ]] bar` is converted, then the output is `

foo bar

`.
